title: Research: P112 Householder-gauge support-cost census (no new kappa)
body:
## Result

Adds a scoped, exact negative result for one symmetric ten-term P112 decoder. The pinned witness from PR1633 has support-rank invoice `(8,8,8,8,8,8,8,8,9,9)`, total 82. The verifier exhausts every rational Householder gauge `O_s=I-2ss^T/(s^Ts)` for nonzero ternary normal `s in {-1,0,1}^10`, modulo sign: 29,524 candidates. All ten terms remain active, every exact P112 identity is preserved by the checked orthogonal numerator, and the candidates produce nine support-rank histograms, all using only ranks 8 and 9. The minimum invoice remains 82.

## Cost screen and limits

Substituting the best ten-term support profile for the selected eight rank-8 centre children changes the centre mass from 64 to 82. Even with all coefficient, frame, precision, hosting, storage and restoration overhead waived, the exact selected-profile ceiling is in `[0.000834274164361244, 0.000834274164361245]`, below the selected fixed-word ceiling `0.001690054109089` and its 5% target `0.00177455681454345`. This closes only the searched Householder orbit of the one pinned symmetric witness. It is not a lower bound for all ten-term, asymmetric or other-support decoders; no supplier adoption or new `kappa` is claimed.

## Reproduction

```sh
python3 -B research/p112-householder-gauge-seed06ace/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --package research/p112-householder-gauge-seed06ace --check-only
```

The direct verifier and package metadata/source-pin check pass locally under Python 3.14.7. The registered replay targets Python 3.12, unavailable locally; that replay remains for CI/reviewer confirmation.
